name: Munna Bhai Saying Nahi
visual_description: Munna Bhai (Sanjay Dutt) in a cyan shirt looking deadpan, with the subtitle 'Nahi' at the bottom.
usage_context: Used to express a blunt, effortless, and straightforward refusal to an unreasonable demand or question.
